### Is 'Truth' Up for Grabs?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-april-24-2020.html
Passage: Proverbs 30:5
Points:
- Modern culture promotes relativism and rejects the reality of absolute truth.
- God’s word is completely pure, trustworthy, and stands entirely on its own authority.
- Biblical truth demands a decision, making genuine neutrality toward Christ impossible.
- Believers must courageously hold fast to God's flawless truth despite cultural resistance.

### Small but Wise
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/small-wise
Passage: Proverbs 30:24-25
Points:
- God has woven practical and moral wisdom into the patterns of the physical world.
- Ants lack individual physical strength, yet they thrive through foresight and preparation.
- Weak creatures accomplish remarkable tasks by working together in harmony.
- Christians should combine their varied spiritual gifts within the church rather than attempting life alone.

### Helpfulness
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/helpfulness
Passage: Proverbs 30:28
Points:
- The small house lizard is fragile enough to catch by hand yet freely roams royal palaces.
- Lizards gained acceptance in homes because they quietly removed nuisance pests without doing damage.
- Regardless of limitations or disadvantages, people can always discover ways to be genuinely useful.
- Living with humble, practical helpfulness earns favor and goodwill even in hostile environments.

### Devotional: Proverbs 30
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-16-psalm-19-proverbs-30-1-timothy-1/
Passage: Proverbs 30:18-19, 24-28
Points:
- Numerical proverbs use structured lists to provoke careful contemplation of everyday life.
- The survival instincts of tiny creatures reflect wisdom given directly by God.
- Human intelligence is similarly a gift from the Creator, making self-sufficiency foolish and ungrateful.
- The wondrous mystery of romantic love is a divine design meant to be honored rather than cheapened.
